name: Coined quantum walk: 3 steps on a cycle of 4 positions in Qiskit
task_prompt: Implement a coined discrete-time quantum walk for 3 steps on a cycle of 4 positions in Qiskit using one coin qubit and 2 position qubits. Construct the conditional +1/-1 modulo-4 shift as an explicit unitary permutation in a declared basis order, apply an H coin each step, compute the exact final position marginal, and assert nonnegativity, normalization, and agreement with an independent NumPy matrix simulation. Return only one complete Python script with no Markdown fences. It must run locally without network access, use fixed seeds whenever randomness is involved, print concise results, and assert every required invariant.
